headline: Semtech Signal Integrity trainee role includes analog behavioral modeling and mixed-level simulation
fact: Semtech posted Digital Design Verification Trainee REQ3462 in Aguascalientes for the Signal Integrity Product Business Unit’s Digital Design group, which develops mixed-signal ICs for data communications and video broadcast. The description allocates 50% of responsibilities to constrained-random digital verification, 10% to analog behavioral modeling and analog/digital mixed-level simulation, and 10% to verification-methodology improvement. SystemVerilog is preferred in the qualifications. This is a training and hiring mandate, not evidence of completed deployment or a specified RNM implementation.

sources.title: Semtech Careers: Digital Design Verification Trainee (REQ3462)
sources.summary: Official public Workday startDate is July 6, 2026. Full duties identify the Signal Integrity Product team and responsibility percentages; applications remained enabled at this check. This is a different business unit from the existing sensing-IC hiring record.
